resources.name: export_sales__weekly__v1_parquet
resources.title: export_sales__weekly__v1 (parquet)
resources.description: U.S. export sales to all destinations per commodity, marketing year and week since MY 2010/11 (metric tons): weekly exports, accumulated exports, outstanding and net sales, commitments, next-MY sales, China and unknown-destination commitments.

licenses.name: public-domain
licenses.title: US Government work, public domain; cite USDA FAS (Export Sales Reporting Program)

fields.name: commodity_id
fields.description: Canonical commodity id (config/vocab/commodities.yaml).

fields.name: market_year
fields.description: Marketing year in WASDE notation, e.g. 2026/27.

fields.name: esr_market_year
fields.description: FAS ESR marketYear: the year the marketing year ends (2027 = 2026/27).

fields.name: my_start
fields.description: First calendar year of the marketing year.

fields.name: week_ending
fields.description: Thursday that ends the reporting week (ISO date).

fields.name: week_of_my
fields.description: Week index within the marketing year: floor((week_ending − MY start)/7) + 1.

fields.name: release_key
fields.description: ESR release (YYYY-MM-DD) that first published this week.

fields.name: release_ts_utc
fields.description: Publication instant of that ESR release (08:30 ET, stored in UTC).

fields.name: release_ts_source
fields.description: api = the API's releaseTimeStamp; calendar_override = a shutdown catch-up week pinned to its actual FAS release date; calendar_rule = the weekly Thursday rule for backfilled history.

fields.name: vintage_quality
fields.description: captured = tracked by weekly pulls since first capture (the latest revision is shown; every vintage is kept in silver); latest_only = backfilled with values as revised by the backfill day.

fields.name: n_destinations
fields.description: Destinations with activity in the week.

fields.name: weekly_exports_mt
fields.description: Exports shipped during the week (MT).

fields.name: accumulated_exports_mt
fields.description: Exports shipped since the start of the marketing year (MT).

fields.name: outstanding_sales_mt
fields.description: Sales not yet shipped for the current marketing year (MT).

fields.name: net_sales_mt
fields.description: Net new sales for the current marketing year during the week (MT; can be negative).

fields.name: total_commitment_mt
fields.description: Accumulated exports + outstanding sales (MT).

fields.name: next_my_net_sales_mt
fields.description: Net sales for the next marketing year during the week (MT). Never added to the current MY.

fields.name: next_my_outstanding_mt
fields.description: Outstanding sales for the next marketing year (MT).

fields.name: china_commitment_mt
fields.description: Total commitment to China (MT).

fields.name: unknown_commitment_mt
fields.description: Total commitment to unknown destinations (MT); can later be reassigned, e.g. to China.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: FAS ESR API endpoint the values come from (an api.data.gov key is required).

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Unit of the *_mt columns (mt = metric tons).

fields.name: net_sales_4wk_avg_mt
fields.description: Mean of the last 4 weekly net sales in this MY (null before week 4).

fields.name: is_latest_week_of_my
fields.description: True on the newest week published for this marketing year.

resources.name: oilseed_crush__monthly__v1_parquet
resources.title: oilseed_crush__monthly__v1 (parquet)
resources.description: U.S. soybean crush per month from NASS Fats & Oils (ESMIS files since the 2015-10-01 release; marketing year September–August): soybeans crushed (short tons and bushels), crude oil (thousand pounds) and meal (short tons) produced, oil and meal yield per bushel, latest revised value with the release that first printed each month.

licenses.name: public-domain
licenses.title: US Government work, public domain; cite USDA NASS (Fats & Oils: Oilseed Crushings, Production, Consumption and Stocks)

fields.name: market_year
fields.description: Soybean marketing year (September–August) in WASDE notation, e.g. 2026/27.

fields.name: my_start
fields.description: First calendar year of the marketing year.

fields.name: month_of_my
fields.description: Month index within the marketing year (1 = September … 12 = August).

fields.name: month
fields.description: First day of the data month (ISO date).

fields.name: crushed_st
fields.description: Soybeans crushed (NASS "tons" = short tons of 2,000 lb).

fields.name: crushed_bu
fields.description: Soybeans crushed in bushels (short tons × 33.3333; 60 lb per bushel, dim_unit).

fields.name: oil_klb
fields.description: Crude soybean oil produced (thousand pounds, NASS "1,000 pounds").

fields.name: meal_st
fields.description: Soybean cake and meal produced (short tons).

fields.name: oil_stocks_klb
fields.description: Crude soybean oil on hand at the end of the month (thousand pounds).

fields.name: oil_yield_lb_bu
fields.description: Crude oil extraction rate, oil_klb × 1000 / crushed_bu (pounds per bushel).

fields.name: meal_yield_lb_bu
fields.description: Meal yield, meal_st × 2000 / crushed_bu (pounds per bushel).

fields.name: crushed_st_first
fields.description: Soybeans crushed as first printed (before NASS revised it in later releases).

fields.name: is_revised
fields.description: True when the latest crushed_st differs from the first print.

fields.name: first_release_key
fields.description: Fats & Oils release (ESMIS release date, YYYY-MM-DD) that first printed the month.

fields.name: first_release_ts_utc
fields.description: Publication instant of that release (15:00 ET, stored in UTC).

fields.name: first_printed_as
fields.description: Column the month was first printed in (current; previous after a shutdown; year_ago or earlier for months before the first ESMIS file).

fields.name: latest_release_key
fields.description: Release whose (latest revised) values are shown.

fields.name: latest_release_ts_utc
fields.description: Publication instant of that release (UTC).

fields.name: n_vintages
fields.description: How many releases printed the month (current, previous, year-ago columns).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: ESMIS zip of the release whose values are shown (from ESMIS files[]).

fields.name: is_latest_month
fields.description: True on the newest month published.

resources.description: Soybean crush pace vs. USDA, point in time: marketing-year-to-date NASS crush as a share of the WASDE crush projection public when NASS first printed each month, what is still needed per month, oil yield vs the WASDE-implied yield, and the same month of the 5 prior marketing years (from MY 2015/16).

fields.name: oil_yield_lb_bu
fields.description: month_oil_klb × 1000 / month_crushed_bu (F3, pounds per bushel).

fields.name: cum_st
fields.description: Marketing-year-to-date crush through the month, NASS vintages public at release_ts_utc (short tons).

fields.name: cum_bu
fields.description: The same in bushels (F1 numerator).

fields.name: n_months_known
fields.description: Months summed in cum_* (always = month_of_my).

fields.name: inputs_max_release_ts_utc
fields.description: Newest NASS release used on the row (<= release_ts_utc, no look-ahead).

fields.name: wasde_release_key
fields.description: WASDE report month (YYYY-MM) whose soybean crush was public at release_ts_utc (ASOF).

fields.name: wasde_release_ts_utc
fields.description: Publication instant of that WASDE (12:00 ET in UTC); always <= release_ts_utc.

fields.name: wasde_proj_est_flag
fields.description: WASDE flag of the crush figure (proj / est / blank for final).

fields.name: wasde_crush_unit_id
fields.description: Native WASDE unit of the crush figure (m_bu = million bushels).

fields.name: wasde_crush_native
fields.description: WASDE U.S. soybean crush for this MY as of release_ts_utc (million bushels).

fields.name: wasde_crush_bu
fields.description: The same in bushels (F1 denominator).

fields.name: wasde_oil_release_key
fields.description: WASDE report month whose soybean oil production was public at release_ts_utc.

fields.name: wasde_oil_release_ts_utc
fields.description: Publication instant of that WASDE (UTC).

fields.name: wasde_oil_unit_id
fields.description: Native WASDE unit of soybean oil production (m_lbs = million pounds).

fields.name: wasde_oil_production_native
fields.description: WASDE U.S. soybean oil production for the same MY label (million pounds; WASDE's oil year runs October–September).

fields.name: wasde_implied_oil_yield_lb_bu
fields.description: WASDE soybean oil production ÷ WASDE soybean crush (pounds per bushel), as of release_ts_utc.

fields.name: pct_of_target
fields.description: cum_bu / wasde_crush_bu (F1).

fields.name: months_remaining
fields.description: Months of the marketing year still to be reported (12 − month_of_my).

fields.name: last_my_remaining_mean_bu

fields.name: last_my_remaining_n
fields.description: Months behind last_my_remaining_mean_bu.

fields.name: n_5yr
fields.description: Prior MYs (of the last 5) with an as-of pct_of_target at the same month (small sample).

fields.name: pct_5yr_mean
fields.description: Mean pct_of_target of those MYs at the same month.

fields.name: pct_5yr_min
fields.description: Minimum of the same.

fields.name: pct_5yr_max
fields.description: Maximum of the same.

fields.name: n_yield_5yr
fields.description: Prior MYs (of the last 5) with an oil yield for the same month.

fields.name: yield_5yr_mean
fields.description: Mean oil yield of the same month in those MYs (lb/bu, as first printed).

fields.name: yield_5yr_min
fields.description: Minimum of the same.

fields.name: yield_5yr_max
fields.description: Maximum of the same.

fields.name: is_latest
fields.description: True on the newest month.

resources.name: cross__export_pace__v1_parquet
resources.title: cross__export_pace__v1 (parquet)
resources.description: Export commitments as a share of the USDA (WASDE) export projection that was public at each ESR release (point in time), with the same week of the 5 prior marketing years.

licenses.name: public-domain
licenses.title: US Government work, public domain; cite USDA FAS and USDA OCE/WAOB

fields.name: commodity_id
fields.description: Canonical commodity id (config/vocab/commodities.yaml).

fields.name: market_year
fields.description: Marketing year in WASDE notation, e.g. 2026/27.

fields.name: esr_market_year
fields.description: FAS ESR marketYear: the year the marketing year ends (2027 = 2026/27).

fields.name: my_start
fields.description: First calendar year of the marketing year.

fields.name: week_ending
fields.description: Thursday that ends the reporting week (ISO date).

fields.name: week_of_my
fields.description: Week index within the marketing year: floor((week_ending − MY start)/7) + 1.

fields.name: release_key
fields.description: ESR release (YYYY-MM-DD) that first published this week.

fields.name: release_ts_utc
fields.description: Publication instant of that ESR release (08:30 ET, stored in UTC).

fields.name: release_ts_source
fields.description: api = the API's releaseTimeStamp; calendar_override = a shutdown catch-up week pinned to its actual FAS release date; calendar_rule = the weekly Thursday rule for backfilled history.

fields.name: vintage_quality
fields.description: captured = tracked by weekly pulls since first capture (the latest revision is shown; every vintage is kept in silver); latest_only = backfilled with values as revised by the backfill day.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Unit of the *_mt columns (mt = metric tons).

fields.name: weekly_exports_mt
fields.description: Exports shipped during the week (MT).

fields.name: accumulated_exports_mt
fields.description: Exports shipped since the start of the marketing year (MT).

fields.name: outstanding_sales_mt
fields.description: Sales not yet shipped for the current marketing year (MT).

fields.name: total_commitment_mt
fields.description: Accumulated exports + outstanding sales (MT).

fields.name: net_sales_mt
fields.description: Net new sales for the current marketing year during the week (MT; can be negative).

fields.name: net_sales_4wk_avg_mt
fields.description: Mean of the last 4 weekly net sales in this MY (null before week 4).

fields.name: next_my_net_sales_mt
fields.description: Net sales for the next marketing year during the week (MT). Never added to the current MY.

fields.name: next_my_outstanding_mt
fields.description: Outstanding sales for the next marketing year (MT).

fields.name: china_commitment_mt
fields.description: Total commitment to China (MT).

fields.name: unknown_commitment_mt
fields.description: Total commitment to unknown destinations (MT); can later be reassigned, e.g. to China.

fields.name: wasde_release_key
fields.description: WASDE report month (YYYY-MM) public at the ESR release (ASOF join).

fields.name: wasde_release_ts_utc
fields.description: Publication instant of that WASDE (12:00 ET in UTC); always <= release_ts_utc.

fields.name: wasde_proj_est_flag
fields.description: WASDE flag of the target (proj / est / blank for final).

fields.name: wasde_unit_id
fields.description: Native WASDE unit of the target (m_bu, k_short_tons, m_lbs).

fields.name: wasde_exports_native
fields.description: WASDE U.S. exports for this MY in native units, as of the ESR release.

fields.name: wasde_exports_mt
fields.description: The same target converted to metric tons with dim_unit.

fields.name: pct_of_target
fields.description: total_commitment_mt / wasde_exports_mt (E1).

fields.name: pct_shipped
fields.description: accumulated_exports_mt / wasde_exports_mt.

fields.name: weeks_remaining
fields.description: ESR weeks still to report in this marketing year.

fields.name: required_weekly_sales_mt
fields.description: (target − commitments) / weeks_remaining (E2).

fields.name: n_5yr
fields.description: Prior marketing years (of the last 5) with an as-of target at the same week_of_my.

fields.name: pct_5yr_mean
fields.description: Mean pct_of_target of those prior MYs at the same week (small sample, n <= 5).

fields.name: pct_5yr_min
fields.description: Minimum of the same.

fields.name: pct_5yr_max
fields.description: Maximum of the same.

fields.name: is_latest_week_of_my
fields.description: True on the newest week published for this marketing year.
